abstract.text: A Project keeps the places for an area or shared effort together. An Activity plans one round of work using those places, with Assignments and Routes for the people involved.

inlineContent.text: Create and manage Projects and Activities in the iOS app. On the web, you can view the Projects and Locations available to your account. The same places can be used for later Activities.

abstract.text: Learn how to organize places and work in LinkMap on iOS and the web.

A Project is the unit of sharing. Its owner can invite collaborators to the same Project, including its map and active Activity data. A collaborator accepts a link or scans a QR code in the iOS app, then chooses the shared Project in Context.

Locations are places you can reuse across Activities in a Project. Regions group broad areas, while Layers help describe levels or surfaces within them. A Route puts those places in the order you want to visit them.
Projects and Locations appear in both the iOS app and the web map. Use the iOS app to manage them, then open the web map to explore the places available to your account.
